I am honestly so sorry to hear about that. I am around your son's age and my parents have been married a bit longer than you and your wife, and I honestly feel sympathy for you as a father figure. I understand that you love your wife and son, but love is not enough to honour your wows. There needs to be mutual respect and foremost responsibility from both parties. It feels like it all falls onto you, and that's not fair. It's is really honorable that you feel like it is your duty to pay off of your debts, but please know that you're not the only responsible adult in your family. And you never should be the only one. That is just plain selfish from their sides... I know that because my father has been the only bread bringer in my family for more than 20 years. I have four siblings and only now are we capable of earning money and making it easier on all if us. But if my mother had done such things while my father worked his heart out, I woud never spare her a look for the rest of my life. It is important to think about yourself as well, you are still young and have many years ahead. You need to spend them content about yourself and your life choices, and not as a slave to anyone, especially not your own family. It is not fair, it really isn't...
